business_summary: CLPS Incorporation, through its subsidiaries, designs, builds, and delivers IT services, solutions, product services and academic education services in Mainland China, Singapore, Hong Kong, the United States, Japan, India, and internationally. It operates in two segments, IT Services and Academic Education Services. The company offers IT consulting services for banking, including system implementation, testing, and enhancement for various functions; service package, such as planning, development, optimization, software quality assurance, and IT staffing; and fintech solutions comprising integrated development, mainframe and open platform integration, mobile apps, quality management, cloud, and big data solutions. It also provides credit card solutions, which include credit card applications, account setup, authorization and activation, settlement, collection, promotion, point systems, anti-fraud, statement, reporting, and risk management; architecture consulting services for core banking systems, and online and mobile banking; and construction consulting, system development, and testing management. In addition, the company provides e-commerce platform; and automotive solutions, which include big data governance, data analysis, intelligent cockpits, in-car experience interaction, and in-car marketplaces. Further, it engages in the provision of Academic education services; CLPS Virtual Banking Platform; Recruitment and Headhunting; fee-for-service training; and provision of software implementation and ongoing management. It serves banking, wealth management, payment services, e-commerce, automotive, and other sectors. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong.
